findings.assessment: costumePose returns ready before every action/cinematic/finish branch when staticReadyOnly. individualPose prioritizes a selected costume. Omitting that side’s base banks, base poses and impactSprite matches the actual render path.

The preloader filters per-side fighter entries before constructing URL Sets. A normal opponent retains its own banks even when sharing an identity or bank family with the static side. Attack effects and detached finish props stay preloaded.

Costume IDs and infernalRules are dependencies; fighter sprite lookup uses stable registry objects. Cleanup cancels the deferred 900 ms timeout before effect replacement/unmount. Image decode callbacks never write React state, so a late decode cannot restore a previous fight or screen.

Already launched Image downloads/decode calls are not canceled on unmount. Cleanup only cancels the deferred timeout. This is the pre-existing preload mechanism; the patch reduces unused work but does not establish a memory budget or guarantee immediate release.

Combat and gallery are rendered for distinct screen states. exitMatch releases the soundtrack, clears match state and returns home. ReserveGallery owns its selection and restores focus to its selected card on preview close; preload completion cannot change those states.

The six authored tests exercise both static sides, mixed banks, shared banks, mirror match, existing multipose costume and non-infernal rules using jsdom Image instrumentation. They were reviewed, not run in this audit. They do not demonstrate native decode, Chromium memory/performance, actual mobile navigation or final browser paths.

preloadReview.recommendedGate: Run the existing focused tests and current complete technical gates on the copied working tree; perform one real combat entry/exit and gallery return check when the browser runtime is available. No gameplay change is required by this read-only review.
